candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (Uradni list RS) — main portal
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national publication point under ZJN-3 art. 52 for all contract notices, award notices, corrections and contract-modification notices by Slovenian contracting authorities, including bank account services, cash handling, POS/ATM, card issuing and payment gateway procurements. Operated by Javno podjetje Uradni list RS d.o.o. on behalf of the Ministry of Public Administration.
candidates.access_status: public, free; publishing side requires one-time free registration
candidates.legal_status: official government publication; reuse of public sector information regime applies
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the notice search/listing pages filtered by CPV (66xxx financial/banking, 30xxx terminals/hardware, 72xxx IT services); persist notice IDs and full notice HTML/PDF; cross-check against TED for above-threshold notices.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from ejn.gov.si guidance pages
queries_used: portal javnih naročil obvestilo o oddaji naročila bančne storitve
enarocanje.si portal javnih naročil iskalnik obvestil Uradni list RS

candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil — Pregled objav (notice search / browse by CPV, buyer, supplier, date)
candidates.why_relevant: The actual queryable index behind the portal. Observed URL pattern encodes filters (e.g. ?f=ponudnik:<matična št>|datum:YYYY,M,D-|cpv:66), which makes deterministic CPV-scoped and supplier-scoped harvesting of banking/payments notices feasible — including tracking which bank or PSP won which authority.
candidates.source_subtype: notice search interface with parameterised URLs
candidates.access_status: public; parameter syntax inferred from an observed live result URL, not independently confirmed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised HTTP GET sweeps over cpv: and datum: filter values; paginate; store raw HTML. Re-derive the filter grammar from the portal's own search form before relying on it.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result revealing deep-link URL grammar; snowball
queries_used: enarocanje.si "pregled objav" iskanje CPV 66110000 bančne storitve portal javnih naročil

candidates.source_name: e-JN — Elektronsko javno naročanje (national e-tendering system)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory system in which Slovenian tender procedures are actually run (bid submission, e-Dossier, e-Auction). Publishes the current live tender list and the operational rules; the counterpart to the notice portal and the place where documentation and deadlines live.
candidates.access_status: public listings; bidding requires SI-PASS authentication
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the 'Aktualna javna naročila' listing page on a daily cadence; join to portal notice IDs; do not attempt authenticated areas.
queries_used: e-JN ejn.gov.si razpis plačilni promet POS terminali javno naročilo

candidates.source_name: e-JN 'Aktualna javna naročila' live tender list
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-friendly-ish list of currently open procedures with authority name, procurement name/ID, publication date, submission deadline and status — the earliest structured signal that a banking/payments tender is live and still biddable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily fetch; JSF/ViewState pagination may require a session-aware fetcher or headless browser. Prefer the OPSI open-data mirror of this list where available.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ejn.gov.si + OPSI dataset cross-reference
queries_used: e-JN ejn.gov.si razpis plačilni promet POS terminali javno naročilo
Slovenia public procurement open data statistika javnih naročil OPSI podatki

candidates.source_name: eNaročanje notice form pages (individual published notice objects)
candidates.why_relevant: Stable per-notice permalink pattern (Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNN) containing the full structured notice body: subject, CPV, estimated value, procedure type, criteria, and for award notices the winning bidder and contract value. This is the atomic record the whole A2 workstream needs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve IDs from the Pregled objav index rather than enumerating blindly; fetch and parse each form page; also capture the /arhiv/<id>/ variant for historical notices.
queries_used: e-JN ejn.gov.si razpis plačilni promet POS terminali javno naročilo

candidates.why_relevant: Publisher/operator of the procurement portal and the official gazette itself; carries the legal instruments (ZJN-3 and amendments, thresholds, implementing rules) plus announcements of portal redesigns and new e-forms that change the data schema our collectors depend on.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency monitoring of the procurement-related news/education stream for schema and legal changes; fetch ZJN-3 consolidated text from PISRS instead of scraping paywalled gazette pages.
queries_used: enarocanje.si portal javnih naročil iskalnik obvestil Uradni list RS

candidates.source_name: ZJN-3 — Zakon o javnem naročanju (consolidated text, PISRS)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines what must be published, by whom, in what form and within what deadlines (e.g. award notice within 30 days of contract conclusion), and how banking/financial service contract values are estimated (on the basis of fees/commissions). This is the ground truth for interpreting completeness and for detecting when a notice is missing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch of the consolidated text plus a low-frequency change watch on the predpis ID.
queries_used: portal javnih naročil obvestilo o oddaji naročila bančne storitve

candidates.source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (Ministry of Public Administration)
candidates.why_relevant: System owner of e-JN. Publishes guidance, FAQ, framework-agreement and joint-procurement programmes (skupna javna naročila), and the annual statistical reports — the place where centralised state-level banking/payment contracts would be announced before they hit the portal.
candidates.access_status: public; site may have migrated under gov.si — treat http host as possibly redirecting
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the directorate's pages under gov.si for guidance and joint-procurement announcements; resolve the canonical current URL before scheduling.
queries_used: e-JN ejn.gov.si razpis plačilni promet POS terminali javno naročilo

candidates.why_relevant: Comprehensive published data on public procurement awarded in Slovenia from 1.1.2013 onward: contracting authority (name, region), procedure (subject, legal basis, procedure type) and bidder (name, country, region). Gives a structured, back-fillable time series of who wins banking/payments contracts, without scraping every notice.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk download via the OPSI/CKAN API, then filter by CPV division 66 and relevant 30/48/72 codes; refresh quarterly.
queries_used: Slovenia public procurement open data statistika javnih naročil OPSI podatki

candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable register of public procurements on the national open-data portal, served by CKAN with an API — the cheapest reliable bulk route into the same notice stream the portal publishes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CKAN package_show / datastore API against the dataset id; schedule incremental pulls and diff against prior snapshot.
queries_used: Slovenia public procurement open data statistika javnih naročil OPSI podatki

candidates.source_name: Annual statistical reports on awarded public contracts (Zbirka letnih statističnih poročil)
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry-prepared, government-confirmed annual aggregates under ZJN-3/ZJNPOV. Useful for sizing the addressable public-sector banking/payments spend and for sanity-checking notice-level collection coverage year over year.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual pull of the report files (PDF/XLSX) via CKAN resources.
queries_used: Slovenia public procurement open data statistika javnih naročil OPSI podatki

candidates.source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — decisions database and search
candidates.why_relevant: Independent review body for procurement legality. Its published decisions reveal contested banking/payments tenders, the technical and financial requirements that were challenged, bidder identities, and cancelled or annulled procedures — information that never appears in the neutral notice text. Also an early warning that a tender will be delayed or re-run.
candidates.legal_status: official decisions; personal-data redaction applied by publisher
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-scoped crawl of the iskalnik (bančne storitve, plačilni promet, POS, bankomat, kartično poslovanje) plus per-decision permalink harvest; monthly cadence.
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila bančne storitve

candidates.source_name: ERAR (KPK) — public money transaction transparency application
candidates.why_relevant: Reported to hold on the order of 131 million transactions of public-sector bodies for the last ~10 years, plus e-invoice data from September 2024. Lets us see actual payments from public bodies to named banks, card processors and terminal vendors — revealing incumbency and real contract run-rates even where no award notice was published (below-threshold buys).
candidates.access_status: public web app; bulk access via OPSI dataset
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the OPSI dataset/API mirror for bulk; query by recipient tax number for each Slovenian bank/PSP/terminal vendor; monthly refresh.
candidates.discovered_via_method: actor-map reasoning (who reveals indirectly) + local-language search
queries_used: ERAR erar.si javna poraba transakcije banke ATM POS podatki

candidates.source_name: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) — Slovenian above-threshold notices
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory EU-level mirror of Slovenian above-threshold notices, in standardised eForms with a documented v3 search API — structurally easier to harvest than the national portal and multilingual. Confirmed to carry Slovenian banking-services awards under CPV 66110000 (e.g. an Aerodrom Ljubljana/Brnik banking services award to SKB d.d.).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Official TED v3 search API filtered country=SVN and CPV in {66xxx, 30xxx terminals, 48/72 payment IT}; daily incremental. Note: below-threshold Slovenian notices are NOT here — do not treat TED as a substitute for enarocanje.si.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English-language search + snowball from portal legal basis
queries_used: TED europa.eu Slovenia contract award notice CPV 66110000 banking services API
Slovenia public procurement portal award notice banking services

candidates.source_name: UL info tok (Uradni list RS commercial tender-monitoring service)
candidates.why_relevant: Run by the portal's own operator; monitors Slovenian portal notices plus TED, with CPV-code-based alerting. Valuable as a coverage benchmark and as a fallback alerting channel, and its help/FAQ pages document the portal's own notice taxonomy authoritatively.
candidates.legal_status: commercial service — ToS likely forbid scraping of subscriber content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read public FAQ/taxonomy pages only; consider a paid subscription for alerting rather than scraping. Do not scrape subscriber-only content.
queries_used: javnirazpisi.com ulinfotok naročniške storitve spremljanje javnih razpisov Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Javnirazpisi.com — tender aggregator and CPV reference
candidates.why_relevant: Claims to sweep 4000+ sources of javna naročila and javni razpisi beyond the national portal (bulletins, newspapers, individual authority websites), so its coverage map points to publication channels our cell would otherwise miss. Also hosts a usable Slovenian CPV-code reference for building the banking/payments code list.
candidates.access_status: public blog and CPV pages; tender feed is subscription
candidates.legal_status: commercial; check ToS before any automated access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-frequency reading of the CPV reference and blog to enrich the glossary and the source map; no bulk scraping.
queries_used: javnirazpisi.com ulinfotok naročniške storitve spremljanje javnih razpisov Slovenija

candidates.why_relevant: A second independent Slovenian notice-monitoring service. Useful as a cross-check on whether our own harvest of the portal is complete, and as a discovery route to authorities publishing outside the main portal.
candidates.access_status: public landing page; feed likely subscription
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual inspection only; use as a benchmark, not a collection target.
queries_used: javnirazpisi.com ulinfotok naročniške storitve spremljanje javnih razpisov Slovenija

candidates.why_relevant: Third-party mirror that exposes Slovenian notices sliced by CPV code in clean, stable URL paths (observed: /cpv/66510000/ for insurance services), which makes it a convenient secondary index for CPV division 66 (financial and insurance services) and a validation set against our primary harvest.
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication; provenance and completeness unverified — never cite as primary
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /cpv/<code>/ paths for 66xxx and payment-hardware codes as a cross-check; always resolve back to the enarocanje.si or TED original before using a fact.
queries_used: enarocanje.si "pregled objav" iskanje CPV 66110000 bančne storitve portal javnih naročil

negative_findings.description: A direct fetch of https://www.enarocanje.si/ returned only the page title and no navigation, search form, notice types, or feed links.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not confirm from the fetch whether the portal offers RSS, bulk export or a public API. This is a HYPOTHESIS of JS-rendered/bot-defended content, not evidence the site is down — search results show it live and widely referenced. Treat as unverified and retry with a headless browser.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The existence or absence of an RSS/export/API endpoint on the primary statutory source determines whether the whole A2 Slovenia pipeline can be a cheap feed reader or must be a rendering crawler.

negative_findings.description: No documented public API for Portal javnih naročil / e-JN was located in this pass, in either Slovenian or English.
negative_findings.result_summary: Machine access appears to run through OPSI (CKAN) datasets and TED rather than a first-party portal API. Only third-party/commercial TED scraper APIs surfaced, which are not authoritative.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Forces the collection design onto OPSI bulk + HTML crawling + TED API, with the fragility and refresh-lag that implies.

negative_findings.description: No live, currently-open Slovenian banking/payments tender (bank account services for the state, cash handling, ATM/POS, card issuing, payment gateway) was surfaced by general web search in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only historical/illustrative items appeared: a TED banking-services award (CPV 66110000, Aerodrom Ljubljana, awarded to SKB d.d.) and generic payment-terminal clauses inside Ljubljana public-transport and Pošta Slovenije tender documentation. General search engines do not index the portal's dynamic result pages well.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that surface web search is not a viable discovery channel for this cell; collection must query the portal/OPSI/TED indexes directly by CPV.

negative_findings.description: The Pregled objav filter grammar (?f=ponudnik:<id>|datum:YYYY,M,D-|cpv:NN) was inferred from a single observed live result URL, not from portal documentation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pattern is plausible and self-consistent but must be re-derived from the portal's own search form before any collector depends on it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector built on a guessed query grammar can silently under-collect without erroring.

negative_findings.description: Two hosts in this cell have uncertain canonical status: wwwpjn2.enarocanje.si (looks like a versioned/secondary portal host) and www.djn.mju.gov.si (http-only, likely migrated to gov.si).
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither was confirmed reachable in this pass; both appear in current search results, so they are recorded as unverified rather than dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pointing a long-lived collector at a soon-to-be-retired host is a silent failure mode; the deterministic liveness pass should resolve canonical hosts first.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact CPV code set for banking & payments in Slovenian practice is not yet fixed. Confirmed anchors so far: 66110000 bančne storitve, 66510000 zavarovalniške storitve, division 66 generally. Codes for POS/ATM hardware, card personalisation, payment gateways and cash-in-transit are not yet enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the authoritative CPV list from the Slovenian 'enotni besednjak javnih naročil' reference and validate each code by test-querying Pregled objav and TED for Slovenian hits.

coverage_gaps.description: Evidencna naročila (below-threshold, record-only procurements) and utilities-sector procurement under ZJNPOV/infrastructure rules are largely invisible in the notice stream, yet a lot of POS/ATM and cash-handling spend sits there.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compensate via ERAR transaction data keyed to bank/PSP/vendor tax numbers, and via the authorities' own 'evidenčna naročila' registers on their websites.

coverage_gaps.description: The key Slovenian public buyers of banking/payments services — Banka Slovenije, Ministrstvo za finance / Uprava RS za javna plačila (UJP), FURS, Pošta Slovenije, SDH-owned entities, larger municipalities — have not been mapped to their portal buyer identifiers in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a buyer actor-map with matične/davčne številke and use them as first-class filters on Pregled objav, Statist and ERAR.

coverage_gaps.description: ZJN-3 requires publication of 'obvestilo o spremembi pogodbe med njeno veljavnostjo' (contract-modification notices), which is where extensions and value increases on multi-year banking contracts appear. No dedicated capture route was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat modification notices as a first-class notice type in the schema and verify the portal's form ID / eForm type for them.

coverage_gaps.description: Uradni list RS is running training on a 'prenova Portala javnih naročil' with new e-forms — a schema migration of the primary source is in progress or imminent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Subscribe to the Uradni list / DJN announcement channels and version the parser against both legacy forms and eForms; re-check before each collection cycle.

coverage_gaps.description: Almost nothing in this cell exists in English apart from TED and a gov.si institutional page; English-only monitoring would miss essentially all below-threshold and national-level notices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Lock the collection glossary to Slovenian terms and use English only for TED and EU-level cross-checks.

brief: Slovenia's public banking/payments tender intelligence has a single statutory creation point: the Portal javnih naročil operated by Uradni list RS at enarocanje.si (notice publication under ZJN-3 art. 52) paired with e-JN at ejn.gov.si (where procedures are actually run and bids submitted). That stream is mirrored three ways that are far easier to harvest than the portal itself — TED for above-threshold notices via its official API, OPSI/CKAN for bulk registers and the Statist award-statistics application covering 2013 onward, and ERAR for the actual money paid to named banks and vendors including below-threshold spend the notice stream never sees. Around them sit an audit layer (DKOM decisions, which expose contested and annulled banking tenders and their requirements) and a commercial monitoring layer (UL info tok, javnirazpisi.com) best used as coverage benchmarks and glossary sources rather than collection targets. The main risks for this cell are a live eForms/portal-redesign migration that will change the notice schema, an unmapped CPV code set for payments hardware and services, and the invisibility of evidenčna (below-threshold) and utilities-sector procurement — all of which push the design toward CPV-parameterised index queries plus ERAR triangulation rather than surface web search, which returned essentially no live Slovenian banking tenders in this pass.
